References

Floating-point and multiple-precision arithmetic

Bailey (2021)

David H. Bailey. A Thread-Safe Arbitrary Precision Computation Package (Full Documentation). MPFUN2015 technical documentation, revised June 13, 2021. Software and source distributions.

Beebe (2017)

Nelson H. F. Beebe. The Mathematical-Function Computation Handbook. Springer, 2017.

GNU MPFR manual

GNU MPFR project. GNU MPFR Manual, transcendental functions.

Goldberg (1991)

David Goldberg. “What Every Computer Scientist Should Know About Floating-Point Arithmetic.” ACM Computing Surveys 23(1), 5–48, 1991. Accessible reprint.

Joldes, Muller, and Popescu (2017)

Mioara Joldes, Jean-Michel Muller, and Valentina Popescu. “Tight and Rigorous Error Bounds for Basic Building Blocks of Double-Word Arithmetic.” ACM Transactions on Mathematical Software 44(2), 2017. 2016 preprint.

Lange and Rump (2020)

Marko Lange and Siegfried M. Rump. “Faithfully Rounded Floating-point Computations.” ACM Transactions on Mathematical Software 46(3), 2020. 2017 preprint.

Lauter (2005)

Christoph Quirin Lauter. “Basic Building Blocks for a Triple-Double Intermediate Format.” INRIA research report RR-5702, 2005.

Muller et al. (2010)

Jean-Michel Muller, Nicolas Brisebarre, Florent de Dinechin, Claude-Pierre Jeannerod, Vincent Lefèvre, Guillaume Melquiond, Nathalie Revol, Damien Stehlé, and Serge Torres. Handbook of Floating-Point Arithmetic. Birkhäuser, 2010.

Popescu (2017)

Valentina Popescu. Towards Fast and Certified Multiple-Precision Librairies. PhD thesis, Université de Lyon, 2017.

Matrix functions

Al-Mohy and Higham (2012)

Awad H. Al-Mohy and Nicholas J. Higham. “Improved Inverse Scaling and Squaring Algorithms for the Matrix Logarithm.” SIAM Journal on Scientific Computing 34(4), C153–C169, 2012.

Al-Mohy, Higham, and Relton (2013)

Awad H. Al-Mohy, Nicholas J. Higham, and Samuel D. Relton. “Computing the Fréchet Derivative of the Matrix Logarithm and Estimating the Condition Number.” SIAM Journal on Scientific Computing 35(4), C394–C410, 2013.

Deadman, Higham, and Ralha (2013)

Edvin Deadman, Nicholas J. Higham, and Rui Ralha. “Blocked Schur Algorithms for Computing the Matrix Square Root.” Applied Parallel and Scientific Computing, LNCS 7782, 171–182, Springer, 2013.

Higham (2008)

Nicholas J. Higham. Functions of Matrices: Theory and Computation. SIAM, 2008.

Fuzzy sets

Zadeh (1965)

Lotfi A. Zadeh. “Fuzzy Sets.” Information and Control 8(3), 338–353, 1965.
